data: You attempt to rid a creature of their held item for the rest of battle. Make a melee attack roll against a target. On a hit, deal {dice} {type} damage and any held item of the target disappears. The item appears back in the target's inventory when the battle is over.
Startles the last Pokémon to act before the user.
The Pokemon that acted immediately before you must make a CHA Saving Throw against your Intimidation/Persuasion DC.
